text: きょう　こそ　このてで　しょうりを　えがくの！

structure.jp: しょうりを　えがくの！

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ puts strong stress on the word before it: 'this one, and no other'. きょう　こそ = 'today for sure'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here shows the tool used to do something. このてで = 'with this hand'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end, with だ left off, is a soft and often girlish way to state something firmly. えがくの = 'I'm going to paint it'.
